claims.text: Greg LaVecchia (Bloom Nutrition) handles zero-motivation days by showing up regardless of internal feeling state. He explicitly decouples the act of showing up from the emotional or physical condition he is in when he wakes up, treating presence as a non-negotiable behavior independent of motivation level.
claims.speaker: Greg LaVecchia
conditions: physical or emotional state is poor
claims.mechanism: Showing up is treated as a fixed behavior not contingent on feeling state; by decoupling action from emotional or physical readiness, the behavior persists even when motivation is absent.

examples.text: Greg LaVecchia describes waking up on many days feeling severely ill due to an autoimmune histamine reaction triggered by eating the wrong foods or leftover food with elevated histamines. Despite waking up feeling, in his words, like absolute dog shit, he still shows up. He presents this as a real, frequent personal constraint rather than a hypothetical, illustrating that his show-up strategy operates even under significant physical impairment.

practices.text: On zero-motivation days, show up physically regardless of how you feel. Do not wait for motivation to arrive before taking action.
